title: Privacy policy
seoDescription: This page explains what personal information Thunikart by Krishnas Orchids, Near KN Hall, Peedampalli Main Road, Pattanam, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 6410
body:
This page explains what personal information Thunikart by Krishnas Orchids, Near KN Hall, Peedampalli Main Road, Pattanam, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641016 ("Thunikart", "we", "us") collects when you use our website, why we collect it, and what we do with it. We have tried to keep it in plain words. By using our website you agree to this policy.

## What we collect

We only collect what we need to sell you clothes and deliver them:

- Your name, email address and mobile number.
- Your delivery addresses and pincode.
- Your orders, returns, refunds, wallet balance and wishlist.
- What is in your cart.
- The email address you use to sign in, or the Google account email if you sign in with Google.
- Basic technical details such as your browser type and the pages you open, so we can keep the site working and safe.

We do not ask for your card number, UPI PIN, net banking password or CVV. Payments are made on the secure payment window of our payment partner, and we never see or store those details.

## Why we use it

- To take and deliver your order, and to tell you its status.
- To send you your login code and order messages by email.
- To process returns, exchanges and refunds, and to keep your wallet balance correct.
- To answer your questions and complaints.
- To prevent fraud and keep the website secure.
- To follow the law, for example for tax and accounts records.

We send offers or newsletters only if you ask for them. You can stop them at any time with the unsubscribe link in the email.

## Who we share it with

We do not sell your information. We share only what is needed with people who help us run the shop:

- Delivery partners (couriers) get your name, address and phone number so they can deliver.
- Our payment partner (Razorpay) handles your payment on its own secure page.
- Our email service sends your login code and order emails.
- Google, only if you choose to sign in with Google.
- Authorities, if the law requires us to share something.

These partners may only use your information to do their job for us.

## How long we keep it

We keep your account details while your account is active. We keep order, invoice and payment records for as long as the law requires for tax and accounts, which is usually several years. After that we delete them or remove your name from them.

## How we protect it

Your login works with a one time code sent to your email, so there is no password to steal. Our systems use encrypted connections (https), and only the staff who need your details to do their work can see them. No website can promise perfect security, so please keep your email account safe too.

## Your choices and rights

You can ask us to:

- Show you the personal information we hold about you.
- Correct anything that is wrong.
- Delete your account and information, except what we must keep by law.
- Stop sending you offers.

You can change your name, mobile number and addresses yourself in My Account. For anything else, write to us using the details on our Contact page. We will reply within a reasonable time, and within the time the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 sets out.

## Cookies

We use a few small files called cookies to keep you signed in and remember your cart. Read our Cookie policy for the full list and how to control them.

## Children

Our website is meant for adults. If you are under 18, please shop with a parent or guardian. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

## Changes to this policy

If we change this policy we will update this page and the date below. If the change is important, we will also tell you on the website.

## Contact us

Questions about your privacy? Write to us at Thunikart by Krishnas Orchids, Near KN Hall, Peedampalli Main Road, Pattanam, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641016, or use the phone number and email on our Contact page.

title: Terms of service
seoDescription: These terms are the rules for using the Thunikart website and buying from Thunikart by Krishnas Orchids, Near KN Hall, Peedampalli Main Road, Pattanam
body:
These terms are the rules for using the Thunikart website and buying from Thunikart by Krishnas Orchids, Near KN Hall, Peedampalli Main Road, Pattanam, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641016. Please read them before you order. When you use the website or place an order, you agree to these terms, our Privacy policy, Cookie policy, Shipping policy and Refund and returns policy.

## Using the website

- You must be 18 or older, or use the website with a parent or guardian.
- Give true and complete details when you sign in or order.
- Keep your email account safe. Anything done with your login is treated as done by you.
- Do not misuse the website: no hacking, scraping, fake orders, or copying our pictures and text.

## Products, colours and prices

We try to show every product as it really is. Colours can look a little different on different screens, and sizes can vary by a small amount between styles, so please check the size chart on the product page.

All prices are in Indian rupees (₹) and include GST where it applies. We may change prices at any time, but the price you saw when you placed your order is the price you pay for that order.

If we find a price or stock mistake on an order, we will tell you and give you the choice to continue at the correct price or cancel for a full refund.

## Placing an order

An order is confirmed when your payment succeeds, or when we accept your cash on delivery order. We hold the items in your cart for a short time (about 15 minutes) while you pay. If the payment does not complete in that time, the items go back on sale.

We can refuse or cancel an order if an item is out of stock, the pincode is not served, we cannot verify the details, or we suspect misuse. If we cancel after you paid, we refund the full amount.

## Payment

You can pay online (UPI, cards, net banking and wallets through our payment partner), with your Thunikart wallet balance, or with cash on delivery where it is offered. Cash on delivery may have a small fee and may not be available at every pincode. The fee is shown before you pay.

## Delivery, returns and refunds

Delivery is covered by our Shipping policy. Returns, exchanges and refunds are covered by our Refund and returns policy. Both are part of these terms.

## Your wallet

Money returned to your Thunikart wallet, for example a refund, can be used for your next order on this website. It cannot be withdrawn as cash. The wallet history in My Account shows every credit and debit.

## Our content

The logo, name, pictures, text and design of this website belong to Thunikart by Krishnas Orchids. You may not copy or use them for business without our written permission.

## Limits on our responsibility

We take care to keep the website running and the information correct, but we cannot promise it will always be available or free from errors. To the extent the law allows, our responsibility for any order is limited to the amount you paid for that order. This does not take away any right you have under consumer protection law.

## Law and disputes

These terms follow the laws of India. If we cannot settle a problem by talking, the courts at Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu will have the authority to decide it. We would always like to solve your problem first, so please contact us before anything else.

## Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. The date at the bottom of this page shows the latest version. Using the website after a change means you accept the new terms.

## Contact us

For any question about these terms, write to us at Thunikart by Krishnas Orchids, Near KN Hall, Peedampalli Main Road, Pattanam, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641016, or use the details on our Contact page.

title: Refund and returns policy
seoDescription: We want you to be happy with what you buy. This page explains how returns, exchanges and refunds work, in simple steps.
body:
We want you to be happy with what you buy. This page explains how returns, exchanges and refunds work, in simple steps.

## When you can return or exchange

- You can ask for a return or exchange within 7 days of getting your order.
- The item must be unused, unwashed, in its original condition, with the tags and packing.
- Keep your invoice or order number. We need it to find your order.

## What cannot be returned

- Items bought at a discount or in a sale cannot be returned or refunded.
- Items that have been worn, washed, altered or damaged after delivery.
- Items without their tags or original packing.
- Gift cards and wallet credit.

If an item is faulty, the rules below for damaged items apply even if it was bought at a discount.

## Damaged, faulty or wrong items

If your item arrives damaged, has a fault, or is not what you ordered, tell us within 48 hours of delivery. Send clear photos (up to 4) with your request. We will arrange a free pickup or replacement, or refund the full amount including delivery.

## How to ask for a return

- Sign in and open My Account, then Orders.
- Open the order and choose Return.
- Pick the items and give the reason. Add photos if the item is damaged.
- We check your request and tell you if it is approved. If it is approved we arrange a pickup where we can, or tell you where to send it.
- When the item reaches us and passes a quick check, we refund you.

## How you get your money back

- To your Thunikart wallet: this is the fastest, and the money is ready to use at once.
- To your original payment method: the refund is started within 3 working days of us receiving the item. Your bank or payment provider can take 5 to 10 working days to show it.
- Cash on delivery orders are refunded to your wallet or to a bank account or UPI you give us.

Shipping charges are refunded only when the return is because of our mistake, for example a damaged or wrong item.

## Exchanges

If you want a different size or colour, ask for an exchange in the same way. We send the new item once the first one is checked, as long as the new one is in stock. If it is not in stock, we refund you.

## If your order is cancelled

You can cancel before your order is packed, from My Account, and we refund the full amount you paid. After packing, please wait for delivery and use the return steps above.

## Questions

If you are not sure about anything here, contact us before you send anything back. The details are on our Contact page.

title: Shipping policy
seoDescription: This page explains where and how we deliver, how long it takes, and what it costs.
body:
This page explains where and how we deliver, how long it takes, and what it costs.

## Where we deliver

We deliver across India through trusted courier partners. Enter your pincode on the product page or at checkout to see if we deliver to you, how long it will take, and what it will cost.

## Delivery time

Most orders are delivered in 2 to 6 working days after they are packed. Orders are usually packed within 1 to 2 working days. Far away or hard to reach places, festivals, bad weather and strikes can add a few days. The estimate for your pincode is shown before you pay.

## Shipping charges

- Orders of ₹999 and above ship free.
- For smaller orders a small shipping fee applies. It is shown in your cart and at checkout before you pay.
- Cash on delivery may carry a small extra fee, shown before you confirm.

## Cash on delivery

Cash on delivery is offered at many pincodes, up to a maximum order value. If it is available for you, you will see it as a choice at checkout. Please keep the exact amount ready.

## Tracking your order

When your order is shipped we email you the courier details. You can also see the status of every order under My Account, Orders, with the steps: confirmed, packed, shipped, out for delivery and delivered.

## If you are not at home

The courier will try to deliver and may call you. If delivery fails after a few tries, the parcel can come back to us. We will contact you to send it again, or refund you, as you prefer. Shipping to send it again may be charged.

## Wrong address

Please check your address and pincode. If a parcel is lost because of a wrong or incomplete address, we may not be able to refund the delivery charge. Tell us as soon as you see a mistake, before the order is packed, and we will try to correct it.

## Damaged parcels

If the parcel looks opened or damaged when it arrives, please take a photo or a short video before opening it and tell us within 48 hours. See our Refund and returns policy for what happens next.

title: Cookie policy
seoDescription: This page explains what cookies are, which ones our website uses, and how you can control them. We keep cookies to the minimum the shop needs to work.
body:
This page explains what cookies are, which ones our website uses, and how you can control them. We keep cookies to the minimum the shop needs to work.

## What is a cookie

A cookie is a small text file that a website saves on your phone or computer. It helps the website remember things, for example that you are signed in or what is in your cart. Some similar tools, such as your browser storage, do the same job, and we call them cookies on this page too.

## The cookies we use

These are needed for the shop to work, so they are always on:

- tk_store_rt: keeps you signed in after you log in with your email code. It is kept safe from scripts, lasts up to 30 days, and is removed when you sign out.
- tk_cart: remembers your cart before you sign in, so your items are still there when you come back or log in.
- tk_consent: remembers your cookie choice so we do not ask you again and again. It lasts 12 months.

These make the shop easier to use:

- Your wishlist, your compare list and the items you looked at recently are saved in your browser storage on your own device. If you are signed in, your wishlist is also kept with your account.

## Cookies from our partners

When you pay, the secure payment window of our payment partner (Razorpay) may set its own cookies to keep your payment safe and to prevent fraud. If you sign in with Google, Google may set cookies as well. We do not control these. Please see their own cookie and privacy policies for details.

## What we do not do

- We do not use cookies to show you advertisements from other websites.
- We do not sell information collected through cookies.
- We do not follow you across other websites.

If we ever add tools to understand how the website is used, for example visitor statistics, we will update this page and ask for your permission first.

## Your choices

- When you first visit, a message asks you to agree. Choose "Agree and continue" to accept, or "Essential only" to keep just the cookies the shop needs.
- You can change your choice any time with "Cookie settings" at the bottom of the website.
- You can also delete or block cookies in your browser settings. If you block the essential ones, you may not be able to sign in or keep items in your cart.

## Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when our website changes. The date at the bottom of this page shows the latest version.

## Contact us

Questions about cookies? Write to Thunikart by Krishnas Orchids, Near KN Hall, Peedampalli Main Road, Pattanam, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641016, or use the details on our Contact page.
